mapper.update: UPDATE digital_team_coordinator_task SET consecutive_failures = 0 WHERE business_id = #{taskId} AND consecutive_failures <> 0

SELECT t.business_id AS task_id, t.task_key, t.expert_id, t.session_id, t.objective, t.expected_output, t.acceptance_criteria, t.dependencies, t.required_capabilities, t.correction_of, p.business_id AS plan_id, p.conversation_id, c.tenant_id, c.project_id, c.session_id AS business_session_id, p.message_id, m.message_text AS overall_request, m.attachment_refs AS message_attachment_refs, pr.name AS project_name, pr.description AS project_description FROM digital_team_coordinator_task t JOIN digital_team_coordinator_plan p ON p.business_id = t.plan_id JOIN digital_team_project_conversation c ON c.business_id = p.conversation_id JOIN digital_team_project_message m ON m.business_id = p.message_id JOIN digital_team_project pr ON pr.business_id = c.project_id WHERE t.business_id = #{taskId}
